Name: Blinking Cursed Mannequins
Author: Dragoon23
Description:
[size=4][b]Blinking Cursed Mannequins[/b][/size][size=3]

Makes the Cursed Mannequins always blinking, staring, or closing its eyes. Customizable.

Config file is generated upon first launch:[/size]

[size=3]Blinking Options:[/size]
[size=3]1. Always blinking. (Default)
2. No blinking and Eyes always opened.
3. No blinking and Eyes always closed.

Apply To Normal Mannequins or not.[/size]

[size=3][size=3]I wanted to know what the blinking cycle of the Cursed Mannequins looked like, made this, and found it hilarious. [/size][/size]

[size=3][b]Note: This will turn off the jumpscare from rotating the cursed mannequins and I'm not sure why. [/b][/size]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Windows.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Works in single player.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]Should be compatible with Linux/Mac/Multiplayer but I only test for Windows/single player so can't say for sure.[/size][/size][/*]
[/list]
